offering_description.value: Sells home furnishings, kitchenware, decor and outdoor goods to households and trade clients through its own stores, websites and catalogs. It designs much of its range as private-label goods made by outside manufacturers.

primary_products.value: kitchenware; furniture; home decor; bedding and bath; lighting

primary_services.value: interior design services; gift registry; furniture delivery and assembly

customer_segment.value: B2C: households furnishing homes, gift buyers and wedding registrants; B2B: interior designers and hospitality businesses through a trade program

revenue_model.value: product sales: home goods sold in stores, online and through catalogs; service fees: delivery, assembly and interior design services

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: designs private-label home goods made by outside manufacturers; retailer: sells to households and trade clients through stores and websites

geography_served.value: global: US stores and websites, stores in Canada and Australia, international franchise partners in Mexico, Middle East and Asia

specialization.value: related lines: kitchenware, furniture, home decor, bedding, outdoor and kids' furnishings

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-owned retail stores and design studios; online: company websites and e-commerce apps; direct sales: trade program for interior designers and hospitality clients; partners / resellers: international franchise partner stores
distribution_channels.category: own locations; online; direct sales; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: consumer product safety rules, such as CPSC standards, consumer data privacy laws
